notes: Born 13 May 1953 at Richland, the third of Howard and Nancy's five children (Ed Simons's tree; public-records index). At Kennewick High School in 1969–70; lived at Vancouver, Washington, in 1993 and at La Verne and Walnut, California, from 1995 to 2002, then back at Kennewick, next door to his sister Sandy on W. 2nd Avenue, from 2001 (yearbooks; public-records indexes). No marriage or children found in the Washington indexes.
